title: Hybrid-NOTES versus conventional laparoscopic cholecystectomy: A retrospective and prospective single-center study comparing long-term surgical outcomes and patient satisfaction
summary:
Minimally invasive surgery is considered particularly gentle, as it requires smaller incisions compared to traditional open procedures. Hybrid NOTES cholecystectomy is a new method in the field of minimally invasive surgery, in which the gallbladder is removed through the vagina, supported by a small additional incision at the navel. This technique is intended to offer patients benefits such as less pain, faster recovery, and minimal visible scarring.
In this study, we aim to survey patients who underwent gallbladder removal either through the conventional laparoscopic technique or the transvaginal hybrid NOTES method. The focus will be on long-term outcomes, particularly patients’ quality of life, body image, and satisfaction with the surgical results, to better assess potential differences between the two techniques.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Minimum age of 18 years
- Radiologically and clinically confirmed indication for cholecystectomy
- For the hybrid-NOTES cholecystectomy cohort, preoperative gynecological evaluation completed
Exclusion criteria:
- age < 18 Jahre
